  • 构造器详细资料

    • AdminRecruitment

      public AdminRecruitment(String jobId, String title, String subject, String workType, String department, String description, String requirements, int openPositions, String deadline, double hoursPerWeek, String compensation, boolean open, String moId)
      Creates a recruitment post record.
      参数:
      jobId - unique job identifier
      title - post title
      subject - subject or module name
      workType - working mode such as remote, hybrid, or on-site
      department - owning department
      description - post description
      requirements - skill and eligibility requirements
      openPositions - maximum number of hires
      deadline - application deadline
      hoursPerWeek - expected workload hours per week
      compensation - compensation text
      open - whether the post is open for applications
      moId - module organizer identifier
